title: Register bound for a register triple
statement: Let $B,p,c,a$ be natural numbers. For any control state and any answer status, if $p\le B$, $c\le B$, and $a\le B$, then the configuration with these three register values has every register at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: The control state and answer status are arbitrary
